requirements: Same-site partial views must not close CURRENT just because no support ray arrived.
A directly observed genuinely separate site can take over when the old site has no support.
Preserve observed-absence, support-clock and history/handoff rules.
candidate_model: Integrate overlap of two world AABBs over the existing one-cell quantization uncertainty; use the same M2a prior and M3 risk instead of the hard possibility test.

mathematical_candidate.quantization: Each map coordinate reference has a uniform half-cell error; relative displacement has triangular support [-r,r]. This is a local association approximation, not an estimate of camera pose covariance.
mathematical_candidate.extent_probability: Product of per-axis CDF differences, under the explicitly stated coordinate-wise approximation.
mathematical_candidate.decision: Compare same-site versus other-site posterior risk using existing q; a tie must preserve the unresolved candidate. Do not close without the existing no-support or measured-absence conditions.

review_before_edit: Explain relation to M1c and shared geometry rather than multiplying correlated summaries as independent camera data.
Check existing tests at touching/overlapping boxes, empty candidate, and known cabinet/table moves.
Restrict edits to the P03 helper and its two listed call sites; document the formula in README first.
